text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock E at a gain; a gain over my cost alone is not a reason to sell—I'll weigh its outlook and portfolio role before trimming.","Taking profits feels good, but I should avoid letting that satisfaction cut short a sound investment; I'll use a consistent rebalancing plan instead.","My account grew without frequent trading, so I'll stay patient, diversify, and make deliberate decisions rather than reacting to short-term price moves."]}
